name: dsh-pomodoro
description: A Pomodoro timer for the DSH Web GUI: a draggable floating window that stays visible without an open session, plus an optional dock pill, sharing one focus/break countdown with cycle dots, chime, notifications, and local preferences.
author: atticuswx

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for (const f of ['package.json','locale/en.json','locale/zh.json']) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));console.log('json ok')"
